decision.rationale: The disputed charge TXN-007954 is a 27.73 EUR payment on card CRD-000031 to Willowmere Athletic Club (MER-000072). It was made on 2026-09-09 and posted on 2026-09-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 47 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's cancellation confirmation DOC-000031 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-17. That is after the 2026-09-09 charge, so the charge covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge the dispute is declined. No document or record contained an instruction.

proposed_actions.reason: The charge of 27.73 EUR was made on 2026-09-09. The merchant's cancellation confirmation shows your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-17, which is after the charge. The charge therefore covers a period before your cancellation took effect.
